domains.description: Screen synthetic paper abstracts for a narrow retrieval benchmark.

include_paper.instructions: Include only studies that evaluate retrieval-augmented language generation with measured factuality or hallucination outcomes. Mere retrieval or generation separately is insufficient.

criteria.proposal: Proposes a method without measured results

criteria: Mentions RAG but no factuality evaluation

state.abstract: We benchmark nearest-neighbor retrieval latency. No language generation is used.

state.title: A survey of RAG
state.abstract: We review 60 papers on retrieval-augmented generation. We conduct no new experiments.

state.title: Planned retrieval verifier
state.abstract: We propose adding retrieval to generation and plan to measure hallucinations in future work.

state.title: RAG speed
state.abstract: We evaluate retrieval-augmented generation runtime and memory only; factual accuracy is not measured.

state.title: Hallucination without retrieval
state.abstract: We measure hallucinations in a closed-book language model. The system never retrieves evidence.

state.abstract: A retrieval-augmented generator is tested on 200 documents. We report factual support and citation correctness.
